recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-37441. No core follow-up is needed for the referenceSeq choice request; any further MolecularDefinition or MolecularSequence retirement work should be handled under the later R6 replacement trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-37441 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Clinical Genomics request to replace the independent MolecularSequence reference sequence representations (CodeableConcept, MolecularSequence reference, and string) with a single choice element, referenceSequence[x].
initial_application: The Jira comment links SHA e3be7248f37efeab08e9625d43bd9ead22c8e824 and PR #1943. That commit removed MolecularSequence.relative.reference.referenceSeqId, referenceSeqPointer, and referenceSeqString from source/molecularsequence/structuredefinition-MolecularSequence.xml and added MolecularSequence.relative.reference.referenceSequence[x] with CodeableConcept, string, and Reference(MolecularSequence) types; PR #1943 was later merged as 6251965e3c7b560768d498941a0ccc7a38cdc7de.
additional_context: FHIR-37486 later renamed the same MolecularSequence area, including referenceSequence[x] to startingSequence.sequence[x], preserving the choice-model intent under different names. In R6, FHIR-51227 approved replacing the legacy MolecularSequence resource with MolecularDefinition. Current source has no source/molecularsequence or source/msq files, molecularsequence is not active in the resource list, and diagnostics-module.html says MolecularSequence has been replaced by MolecularDefinition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has no stale referenceSeqId/referenceSeqPointer/referenceSeqString pattern to fix, and editing MolecularDefinition would go beyond the R5 MolecularSequence request and the later replacement decision.
